message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: drunk driving. In Chinese criminal law, drunk driving that causes dangerous consequences may be "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving) under Article 133 of Criminal Law. If only drunk driving without causing accident, still dangerous driving? Actually Article 133: "在道路上驾驶机动车辆，醉酒后驾驶的，处拘役，并处罚金。" That's "dangerous driving" (危险驾驶罪). So the crime is dangerous driving. In examples, they used "危险驾驶". For example earlier: "危 难驾驶;私分国有资产". So answer: [罪名]危险驾驶<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes? No. So single crime.
